reviews.text:
I had purchased the Mixsoon Bean Essence from Amazon and I had a feeling it was fake. I purchased it from
Olive Young and compared it to the one I already had. You can clearly see the difference! So happy to be able to purchase original products from Olive Young and not the fake stuff from somewhere else.
reviews.zh: 之前喺Amazon買咗Mixsoon Bean Essence，一直覺得似係假貨。之後喺Olive Young買咗一枝同手頭上嗰枝對比，分別一睇就知！好開心可以喺Olive Young買到正貨，而唔係其他地方嘅假嘢。

reviews.text: I absolutely love the Mixsoon Bean Essence! Its texture is so smooth and gentle on the skin. It hydrates deeply while effortlessly removing dead skin cells, leaving my face feeling soft, fresh, and glowing. I’ve noticed such a healthy radiance since using it—it really helps with skin texture and gives that clean, glass-skin look. It’s become a must-have in my routine
reviews.zh: 我超級鍾意Mixsoon Bean Essence！質地超滑，對皮膚好溫和。深層保濕之餘又輕鬆帶走老廢角質，用完塊面又軟又清爽又有光澤。用咗之後見到膚色健康咗有光澤，皮膚質地改善晒，輕鬆做到水光玻璃肌效果。已經成為我日常必備。

reviews.text:
Me gustó bastante, yo soy de piel muy seca y estaba batallando para encontrar productos que me darán una sensación de humectacion al instante, gracias a tiktok descubrí que igual se puede usar como exfoliante y la piel se siente super suave. 
Yo tengo rosasea y en general la textura de mi piel ha mejorado bastante
reviews.zh: 我覺得好好用，我屬於極乾肌，一直搵唔到可以即時畀到我保濕感嘅產品，多謝tiktok令我發現原來佢都可以當磨砂用，皮膚用完超級滑。我有玫瑰痤瘡，但整體皮膚質地改善咗好多。

reviews.text: I have repurchased the Mixsoon Bean Essence three times, and it continues to exceed my expectations each time. This product has become an indispensable part of my skincare routine. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling incredibly hydrated and smooth. Over time, I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my skin’s texture and overall radiance. I love how it enhances my complexion, making it look healthier and more youthful. Highly recommend to anyone seeking an effective and reliable skincare solution! Five stars all the way!
reviews.zh: 我已經回購Mixsoon Bean Essence三次，每次都超越我嘅期望。呢款產品已經成為我護膚程序中不可或缺嘅一部分。質地輕盈，吸收得快，皮膚感覺極之水潤又滑。持續用落去，皮膚質地同整體光澤都有明顯改善。佢可以提升膚色，令皮膚睇落更健康更年輕。強烈推薦畀所有想搵有效可靠護膚品嘅人！五粒星實至名歸！

reviews.text:
I used tretinoin - BIG mistake. My skin turned very sensitive and dry, and when I put skincare on, it would burn and make it look darker. I then bought this product along with others. Here is my review on all of them. I hope this helps!~♡

~ 1: Super gentle and non-irritating!10/10!!

~ 2: Couldn’t rub on my skin since I can’t exfoliate, but as a face mask, it cooled and calmed down my skin, decreased breakouts and lightened my hyperpigmentation.10/10!!

~ 3: If you don't want exfoliation, then this isn't for you. Pretty hydrating, but heavy. Switching to Torriden DIVE IN serum.8/10!!

~ 4: I didn't use it for enough time to do a proper review since it broke, though, it was very lightweight and calmed down my skin.The Mixsoon Centella Essence was heavier, which i didn't like.10/10!!

~ 5: At the start, it would make my skin irritated, but I then found it very lightweight, hydrating and cooling.10/10!!

Overall, my skin became less sensitive and smoother thanks to these products :)
reviews.zh:
我用咗 A 酸——大錯特錯。我塊面變得好敏感同乾燥，搽護膚品嘅時候會刺痛，望落去仲深色咗。我之後買咗呢件產品同其他嘢一齊。以下係我對佢哋嘅評價，希望幫到大家！~♡

~ 1：超溫和，零刺激！10/10！！

~ 2：因為我唔可以去角質所以搽唔到面，但當面膜用，佢幫我塊面降溫同舒緩咗，減少咗爆瘡，仲淡咗我啲色素沉澱。10/10！！

~ 3：如果你唔想去角質，咁呢個就唔啱你。保濕效果唔錯，但比較厚重。轉咗用 Torriden DIVE IN 精華。8/10！！

~ 4：因為支樽爛咗，所以我用嘅時間唔夠長，做唔到一個完整嘅評價，不過佢好輕盈，仲舒緩到我塊面。Mixsoon 積雪草精華比較厚重，我就唔鍾意。10/10！！

~ 5：開頭用會令皮膚有啲刺激，但之後我發現佢好輕盈、保濕，仲有涼浸浸嘅感覺。10/10！！

整體嚟講，多謝呢啲產品，我塊面冇咁敏感，滑咗好多 :)

reviews.text: This absorbs so quickly. It is definitely moisturizing. If you have sensitive skin or have redness, then putting too much on your face can cause more redness. It is better to use it to exfoliate the pores and blackhead you may have and then using a toner pad to gently wipe it. Doing this method helped my skin so much without my cheeks turning extremely red.
reviews.zh: 呢支吸收得超快，保濕效果實在有。如果係敏感肌或者容易泛紅，搽太多落塊面會令泛紅更加嚴重。最好嘅用法係先用佢清理毛孔同黑頭，再用爽膚棉片溫和咁抹。咁樣用幫到我皮膚好多，唔會搞到兩邊面頰紅晒。

reviews.text: I was shocked when I rolled this on my face for a good minute - there was black (which I assume is pollution and dirt) and white (probably oil and sebum) dead skin rolling out from my face! I rolled for another 3 min with extra pumps and after washing off with warm water, my face felt exfoliated yet not stimulated.
reviews.zh: 我將呢支喺塊面碌咗成一分鐘——居然碌到黑色（我估係污染物同污垢）同白色（應該係油脂同皮脂）嘅死皮出晒嚟！我再碌多 3 分鐘，唧多咗幾泵，用溫水洗走之後，塊面感覺去咗角質又唔刺激。

reviews.text: I had a bad allergy reaction on my face after I used this product, which caused me to go to Urgent care twice in one week. I am in my late 30s and I never had any allergy reaction to any skincare products in my life, which includes SKII. I bought this since many YouTubers suggest it, but sadly it was not workout. So be careful if you want to try this. I ended up throwing all mixsoon products that I bought.
reviews.zh: 用咗呢個產品之後我塊面出現嚴重過敏反應，搞到我要一個星期之內去急症室兩次。我已經三十幾歲，之前從來冇對任何護膚品（包括 SKII）出現過敏反應。我因為好多 YouTuber 推薦所以買咗，可惜啱唔到我。所以想試嘅話要小心啲。最後我將買返嚟嘅 mixsoon 產品全部掉晒。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
